crew.overview: Based on Frank Miller's graphic novel, "300" is very loosely based the 480 B.C. Battle of Thermopylae, where the King of Sparta led his army against the advancing Persians; the battle is said to have inspired all of Greece to band together against the Persians, and helped usher in the world's first democracy.
An Eastern European tourist unexpectedly finds himself stranded in JFK airport, and must take up temporary residence there.
crew.title: The Terminal

crew.overview: Taking place after alien crafts land around the world, an expert linguist is recruited by the military to determine whether they come in peace or are a threat.
crew.title: Arrival

crew.overview: Spanning over one thousand years, and three parallel stories, The Fountain is a story of love, death, spirituality, and the fragility of our existence in this world.
crew.title: The Fountain

crew.overview: A young girl is raised in a dysfunctional family constantly on the run from the FBI. Living in poverty, she comes of age guided by her drunkard, ingenious father who distracts her with magical stories to keep her mind off the family's dire state, and her selfish, nonconformist mother who has no intention of raising a family, along with her younger brother and sister, and her other older sister. Together, they fend for each other as they mature in an unorthodox journey that is their family life.
crew.title: The Glass Castle

details.biography:
Nicolas Lepage is an award winning Production Designer with over 25 years of experience in world building and visual storytelling on acclaimed projects for film and television. Nico recently completed production of Francis Lawrence’s awaited adaptation of Stephen King’s The Long Walk. He also designed Alberto Belli’s crazy heist hit The Naughty Nine  for Disney Channel, the magical napoleonic war torn Spain of Tobey Haynes’ Jonathan Strange & Mister Norrell and 3 seasons of Jean-François Rivard’s acclaimed show Les Invincibles. His work on Luc Picard’s fantasy tales Esimésac and Babine won him a Jutra Award and a nomination for a Director’s Guild of Canada Award.

Other credits include Supervising Art Director on The Last of Us  for HBOMax (ADG Award), Doug Liman’s Chaos Walking, Destin Daniel Cretton’s The Glass Castle and Steven Knight’s dystopian series See for AppleTV+. Also, as Art Director on multi award winning and box office hits such as 300, The Fountain, The Mummy 3, The Terminal, Confessions of a Dangerous Mind, Arrival and the first season of The Handmaid's Tale (ADG Award).
details.name: Nicolas Lepage
